arxiv-2104-04022.title: Controlling phase separation in microgel-polymeric micelle mixtures using variable quench rates
arxiv-2104-04022.creator: S L Fussell, ∗ 123 C P Royall, 1234 and J S van Duijneveldt a
arxiv-2104-04022.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S L Fussell, ∗ 123 C P Royall, 1234 and J S van Duijneveldt a. We investigate the temperature dependent phase behaviour of mixtures of poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) (pNIPAM) microgel colloids and a triblock copolymer (PEO-PPO-PEO) surfactant, which undergoes micellisation. Gelation in these systems results from an increase in temperature. Here we alter the heating rate and observe that the mechanism for aggregation changes from one of depletion of the microgels by the micelles at low temperatures to association of the two species at high temperatures.

arxiv-2105-14101.title: Pressure-induced structural transitions triggering dimensional crossover in lithium purple bronze Li 0.9 Mo 6 O 17
arxiv-2105-14101.creator: M. K. Tran, A. Akrap, J. Levallois, J. Teyssier, P. Schouwink, C. Besnard, P. Lerch, J. W. Allen, M. Greenblatt, D. van der Marel
arxiv-2105-14101.description: Abstract At ambient pressure, lithium molybdenum purple bronze (Li 0.9 Mo 6 O 17 ) is a quasi-one dimensional solid in which the anisotropic crystal structure and the linear dispersion of the underlying bands produced by electronic correlations possibly bring about a rare experimental realization of Tomomaga-Luttinger liquid physics.

arxiv-2205-08891.creator: Jingqing Zhang, Atri Sharma, Luis Bolanos, Tong Li, Ashwani Tanwar, Vibhor Gupta, Yike Guo
arxiv-2205-08891.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jingqing Zhang, Atri Sharma, Luis Bolanos, Tong Li, Ashwani Tanwar, Vibhor Gupta, Yike Guo. arxiv-2211-05543.title: Vis2Mus: Exploring Multimodal Representation Mapping for Controllable Music Generation
arxiv-2211-05543.creator: Runbang Zhang, Yixiao Zhang, Kai Shao, Ying Shan, Gus Xia
arxiv-2211-05543.description: Abstract In this study, we explore the representation mapping from the domain of visual arts to the domain of music, with which we can use visual arts as an effective handle to control music generation. Unlike most studies in multimodal representation learning that are purely data-driven, we adopt an analysis-by-synthesis approach that combines deep music representation learning with user studies.

arxiv-2310-05055.title: FairTune: Optimizing Parameter Efficient Fine Tuning for Fairness in Medical Image Analysis
arxiv-2310-05055.creator: Raman Dutt, Ondrej Bohdal, Sotirios A. Tsaftaris, Timothy Hospedales
arxiv-2310-05055.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Raman Dutt, Ondrej Bohdal, Sotirios A. Tsaftaris, Timothy Hospedales. Training models with robust group fairness properties is crucial in ethically sensitive application areas such as medical diagnosis. Despite the growing body of work aiming to minimise demographic bias in AI, this problem remains challenging. A key reason for this challenge is the fairness generalisation gap: High-capacity deep learning models can fit all training data nearly perfectly, and thus also exhibit perfect fairness during training.

arxiv-2403-19343.title: Running Coupling and Running Quark Mass Effects on the Elastic Form Factors of Nucleons
arxiv-2403-19343.creator: Bao-Yi Yang, Hui-Hua Zhong, Muyang Chen

arxiv-2410-07810.title: Towards Robust IoT Defense: Comparative Statistics of Attack Detection in Resource-Constrained Scenarios
arxiv-2410-07810.creator: Zainab Alwaisi, Simone Soderi
arxiv-2410-07810.description: Abstract Resource constraints pose a significant cybersecurity threat to IoT smart devices, making them vulnerable to various attacks, including those targeting energy and memory. This study underscores the need for innovative security measures due to resource-related incidents in smart devices.

arxiv-2411-08353.title: Everything You Wanted to Know About Consumer Light Management in Smart Energy
arxiv-2411-08353.creator: Prajnyajit Mohanty, Umesh C. Pati, Kamalakanta Mahapatra, Saraju P. Mohanty
arxiv-2411-08353.description: Abstract Consumer lighting plays a significant role in the development of smart cities and smart villages. With the advancement of (IoT) technology, smart lighting solutions have become more prevalent in residential areas as well. These solutions provide consumers with increased energy efficiency, added convenience, and improved security.

pmc-10650565.title: Alginate Modified Magnetic Polypyrrole Nanocomposite for the Adsorptive Removal of Heavy Metal
pmc-10650565.creator: Fouzia Mashkoor, Mohd Shoeb, Changyoon Jeong, Suguna Perumal
pmc-10650565.description: The presence of heavy metals with high acute toxicity in wastewater poses a substantial risk to both the environment and human health. To address this issue, we developed a nanocomposite of alginate-encapsulated polypyrrole (PPy) decorated with α-Fe2O3 nanoparticles (Alg@Mag/PPy NCs), fabricated for the removal of mercury(II) from synthetic wastewater.

pmc-11353625.title: Identification of Nonsynonymous SNPs in Immune-Related Genes Associated with Pneumonia Severity in Pigs
pmc-11353625.creator: Hiroki Shinkai, Kasumi Suzuki, Tomohito Itoh, Gou Yoshioka, Takato Takenouchi, Haruki Kitazawa, Hirohide Uenishi, Chunjin Li
pmc-11353625.description: We previously showed that several polymorphisms in genes encoding pattern recognition receptors that cause amino acid substitutions alter pathogen recognition ability and disease susceptibility in pigs. In this study, we expanded our analysis to a wide range of immune-related genes and investigated polymorphism distribution and its influence on pneumonia in multiple commercial pig populations.

pmc-11503204.title: Molecular changes driving low-grade serous ovarian cancer and implications for treatment
pmc-11503204.creator: Lucy Kelliher, Roni Yoeli-Bik, Lisa Schweizer, Ernst Lengyel
pmc-11503204.description: Low-grade serous ovarian cancer was previously thought to be a subtype of high-grade serous ovarian cancer, but it is now recognized as a distinct disease with unique clinical and molecular behaviors. The disease may arise de novo or develop from a serous borderline ovarian tumor.

pmc-11690955.title: ADAPTATION OF GAMEPLAN4CARE FOR HOSPITAL CARE AND CARE TRANSITIONS
pmc-11690955.creator: Molly Horstman, Tracy Evans, Crystal Guo, Mandi Sonnenfeld, Aanand Naik, Alan Stevens, Mark Kunik
pmc-11690955.description: Adults with dementia rely on family caregivers after hospital discharge. Increased caregiver stress following discharge may lead to worse outcomes for caregivers and adults with dementia. Our aim was to adapt GamePlan4Care, a community-based caregiver support intervention, to support caregivers of hospitalized adults with dementia. GamePlan4Care combines online, self-directed skills training with four phone calls from a dementia care specialist.

pmc-12565250.title: Evaluation of Wood Decay and Identification of Fungi Found in the USS Cairo, a Historic American Civil War Ironclad Gunboat
pmc-12565250.creator: Robert A Blanchette, Benjamin W Held, Claudia Chemello, Paul Mardikian, Jiao Pan
pmc-12565250.description: Studies of microbial degradation of historic woods are essential to help protect and preserve these important cultural properties. The USS Cairo is a historic Civil War gunboat and one of the first steam-powered and ironclad ships used in the American Civil War.

pmc-12604122.title: Complete chloroplast genomes analysis of Lamium barbatum and Leucas ciliata (Lamiaceae)
pmc-12604122.creator: Qing Du, Baoxiang Xue, Benyi Tan
pmc-12604122.description: The two Lamioideae species, Lamium barbatum Siebold & Zucc. 1846, is distributed across Europe, North Africa, Asia, and North America, while Leucas ciliata Hochst. ex Benth. 1829 is found in southern China and Southeast Asia. We sequenced their complete chloroplast genomes using the Illumina platform, obtaining lengths of 150,887 bp and 151,259 bp, respectively.

pmc-12646083.title: Primary umbilical malignant melanoma requiring full-thickness abdominal wall resection and reconstruction with autologous fascia lata: a case report
pmc-12646083.creator: Yasue Kurokawa, Yoshihiro Sowa, Soichiro Kado, Yuki Kimura, Takeo Maekawa, Mayumi Komine, Kotaro Yoshimura
pmc-12646083.description: Primary malignant melanoma of the umbilicus is extremely rare; evidence guiding optimal resection and reconstruction is limited. A 47-year-old man with primary umbilical melanoma underwent full-thickness abdominal wall resection including the peritoneum. The abdominal wall defect was reconstructed using an autologous fascia lata graft. Histopathology confirmed malignant melanoma with a tumor thickness of 18 mm (pT4bN1aM0, Stage IIIC).

pmc-12705715.title: Lateral suspension vs. sacral colpopexy for treating pelvic organ prolapse: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12705715.creator: Andrea Lombisani, Veronica Tius, Chiara Ferraro, Martina Arcieri, Lorenzo Vacca, Daniela Caramazza, Stefano Restaino, Tommaso Simoncini, Giampiero Capobianco, Alfredo Ercoli, Giovanni Scambia, Giuseppe Vizzielli, Giuseppe Campagna
pmc-12705715.description: PurposeAlthough sacral colpopexy is considered the gold standard for correcting apical prolapse, it is associated with extended operative times and surgical complications. An alternative surgical approach is currently being investigated. This meta-analysis aims to summarize and compare the available data on laparoscopic sacral colpopexy (LSCP) and laparoscopic lateral suspension (LLS) as per the Dubuisson technique.

pmc-12719220.title: Linear predictive coding electroencephalography algorithms predict mortality in Parkinson’s disease
pmc-12719220.creator: Simin Jamshidi, Arturo I Espinoza, Jonathan T Heinzman, Patrick May, Ergun Y Uc, Nandakumar S Narayanan, Soura Dasgupta
pmc-12719220.description: Highlights•Mortality increases in Parkinson's disease (PD) and is difficult to predict because of lack of reliable prognostic markers.•We used two minutes of EEG recordings and the Linear Predictive Coding EEG Algorithm for PD (LEAPD) to assess mortality.•We used LEAPD to classify 3-year mortality status and correlate LEAPD indices with time to death.

pmc-13217444.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Reduce Aortic Dissection and Hypertensive Crisis in Diabetic Patients with Aortic Aneurysm: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13217444.creator: Yung-Fong Tsai, Huan-Tang Lin, Yu-Fang Liu, Renin Chang, Shao-Chun Wu
pmc-13217444.description: PurposeAortic aneurysm rupture and dissection carry mortality exceeding 50%, yet evidence-based medical therapies for this high-risk population remain limited. Despite mechanistic evidence suggesting glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RAs) stabilize vascular inflammation, no large-scale study has evaluated their impact on acute aortic events in diabetic patients with pre-existing aortic aneurysm.
